briefdescription.para: Resolve a SchedClass at runtime, where SchedClass identifies an MCSchedClassDesc with the isVariant property.

detaileddescription.para: This may return the ID of another variant SchedClass, but repeated invocation must quickly terminate in a nonvariant SchedClass.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if MI is a dependency breaking zero-idiom instruction for the subtarget.

detaileddescription.para: This function also sets bits in Mask related to input operands that are not in a data dependency relationship. There is one bit for each machine operand; implicit operands follow explicit operands in the bit representation used for Mask. An empty (i.e. a mask with all bits cleared) means: data dependencies are "broken" for all the explicit input machine operands of MI.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if MI is a dependency breaking instruction for the subtarget.

detaileddescription.para: Similar in behavior to isZeroIdiom. However, it knows how to identify all dependency breaking instructions (i.e. not just zero-idioms).
As for isZeroIdiom, this method returns a mask of "broken" dependencies. (See method isZeroIdiom for a detailed description of Mask).

briefdescription.para: Returns true if MI is a candidate for move elimination.

detaileddescription.para: A candidate for move elimination may be optimized out at register renaming stage. Subtargets can specify the set of optimizable moves by instantiating tablegen class IsOptimizableRegisterMove (see llvm/Target/TargetInstrPredicate.td).
SubtargetEmitter is responsible for processing all the definitions of class IsOptimizableRegisterMove, and auto-generate an override for this method.

briefdescription.para: True if the subtarget should run MachineScheduler after aggressive coalescing.

detaileddescription.para: This currently replaces the SelectionDAG scheduler with the "source" order scheduler (though see below for an option to turn this off and use the TargetLowering preference). It does not yet disable the postRA scheduler.

briefdescription.para: True if the machine scheduler should disable the TLI preference for preRA scheduling with the source level scheduler.
True if the subtarget should run MachinePipeliner.
True if the subtarget should run WindowScheduler.
True if the subtarget should enable joining global copies.

detaileddescription.para: By default this is enabled if the machine scheduler is enabled, but can be overridden.

briefdescription.para: True if the subtarget should run a scheduler after register allocation.

detaileddescription.para: By default this queries the PostRAScheduling bit in the scheduling model which is the preferred way to influence this.

briefdescription.para: True if the subtarget should run a machine scheduler after register allocation.
True if the subtarget should run the atomic expansion pass.
True if the subtarget should run the indirectbr expansion pass.
Override generic scheduling policy within a region.

detaileddescription.para: This is a convenient way for targets that don't provide any custom scheduling heuristics (no custom MachineSchedStrategy) to make changes to the generic scheduling policy.

briefdescription.para: Override generic post-ra scheduling policy within a region.

detaileddescription.para: This is a convenient way for targets that don't provide any custom scheduling heuristics (no custom MachineSchedStrategy) to make changes to the generic post-ra scheduling policy. Note that some options like tracking register pressure won't take effect in post-ra scheduling.
